mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion, while fenofibrate is renally cleared and can cause myopathy; concurrent use increases risk of acute kidney injury, rhabdomyolysis, and severe myositis.
action: Monitor renal function and creatinine kinase closely; consider discontinuing fenofibrate during amphotericin B therapy or use lipid formulation of amphotericin B to minimize nephrotoxicity.
